facts.statement: CTS DSR RI or DCD change produces 4th Modem Status interrupt cleared by reading Modem status register
facts.quote:
0 0 0 4 th Modem Status CTS, DSR, RI or DCD. Reading the Modem
status register.

facts.statement: IIR reports Modem Status as 4th priority 000 below RLS RDA Timeout THRE with reset by MSR read
facts.quote:
0 0 0 4 th Modem Status CTS, DSR, RI or DCD. Reading the Modem
status register.

facts.statement: MSR delta bits set to 1 on corresponding line change and reset on MSR read
facts.quote:
These bits are set to
‘1’ when a change in corresponding line has been detected and they are reset when the
register is being read.

facts.statement: MSR bit0 DCTS indicates CTS line changed state
facts.quote: ‘1’ – The CTS line has changed its state.

facts.statement: MSR bit1 DDSR indicates DSR line changed state
facts.quote: ‘1’ – The DSR line has changed its state.

facts.statement: MSR bit2 TERI detects RI low to high trailing edge
facts.quote:
Trailing Edge of Ring Indicator  (TERI) detector. The RI line has
changed its state from low to high state.

facts.statement: MSR bit3 DDCD indicates DCD line changed state
facts.quote: ‘1’ – The DCD line has changed its state.

facts.statement: MSR is 8 bit read only at bus address 6
MCR Loopback 0 is normal operation and 1 is loopback with STX held at 1
facts.quote:
‘0’ – normal operation
 ‘1’ – loopback mode. When in loopback mode, the Serial
Output Signal (STX_PAD_O) is set to logic ‘1’.

facts.statement: IIR bits 4 and 5 are 0 and bits 6 and 7 are 1 with reset C1h
